name: crm.cold.outreach
description: Automatically send personalized cold emails to providers, investors, and partners using Zoho Mail (info@doctarx.com). Rate-limited and CAN-SPAM compliant. Requires campaign approval.
author: DoctaRx Genesis

steps.name: Check for approved campaigns ready to send
steps.query: SELECT c.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_contacts ct WHERE ct.contact_type = c.target_contact_type AND ct.is_active = true AND ct.opt_out = false AND ct.email IS NOT NULL AND ct.id NOT IN (SELECT contact_id FROM crm_interactions WHERE campaign_id = c.id AND interaction_type = 'email_sent')) as remaining_contacts FROM crm_campaigns c WHERE c.status IN ('approved', 'running') ORDER BY c.created_at

steps.name: Generate personalized email variations using Gemini
steps.prompt: Given a cold email template, generate 3 personalized variations that maintain the core message but vary the opening hook and CTA. Target: healthcare providers. Tone: professional, warm, value-first. Include personalization tokens: {{first_name}}, {{specialty}}, {{organization}}.

steps.name: Send batch of emails via Zoho Mail
